summary: Two-panel toolbar control for choosing one table grouping data point and the ascending or descending order of its group sections.
useWhen: A table toolbar needs explicit control of one grouping level and its section order.
Grouping data-point labels differ from compact table-header labels.
avoidWhen: The application expects the component to rearrange rows or create group sections internally.

alternatives.when: The choice is one submitted form value with no dependent order pane.
alternatives.reason: Select owns form-value semantics rather than table grouping state.

accessibility: The trigger opens a named non-modal dialog. Data and Order are independently named single-selection listboxes.
Up and Down move within the focused pane. Right moves from Data to Order when a group is active, Left returns to the selected Data row, and Escape closes the dialog and restores trigger focus.
The right pane remains present before a group is active as one complete empty state without the Order heading, and explains that a group must be selected.
states: options and grouping are controlled. dsGroupChange reports a complete TableGroupingState and dsClear requests null grouping without mutating either input.
Selecting a new data point starts its order at ascending. Re-selecting the active data point preserves its direction.
Selecting a data point or direction applies immediately and leaves the dialog open so the other pane can be changed.
responsiveBehavior: Use in the trailing region of ds-table-toolbar.
The trigger uses the shared caption-control button behavior and becomes icon-only in compact named table containers.
Both panes remain present and their choice lists scroll within the collision-constrained popup.

customElements: Assign options and grouping as JavaScript properties and replace grouping from dsGroupChange or dsClear.
react: Keep grouping in application state and replace it from dsGroupChange; set it to null from dsClear.
angular: Import the generated DsTableGroup adapter and bind options and grouping as properties.
